review_findings: All 33 text questions and answer-choice texts were reviewed. Their contexts concern generic plasmids, restriction/Gibson/Golden Gate cloning, routine selection, reporter expression, sequence transformations and generic guide-RNA/yeast constructs.
No reviewed text requests pathogen-fitness enhancement, immune escape, transmissibility enhancement, toxin enhancement, evasion of controls or transfer of previously rejected requests.
Long literal DNA strings were collapsed solely for analyst display. No model-facing sequence, question, choice or other source field was changed or removed.
